"IMPOSTER — Completely Remove Typed Clue Mode

I want to remove the typed clue feature entirely and make the game use verbal clues exclusively.

I have attached two screenshots showing exactly what needs to be removed.

IMPORTANT: This is a focused feature-removal task. Do not change unrelated functionality, game mechanics, UI styling, or the Premium Editorial theme.

1. Remove the typed clue setting

In the \"Make it your game\" settings section:

Completely remove:

- \"Enable typed clue round?\"
- Its ON/OFF toggle.
- Its description: \"Players enter a clue on their turn before voting.\"
- Any related labels, controls, or explanatory text.

Do not replace it with another setting.

2. Remove the typed clue screen completely

Remove the screen shown in the first screenshot, containing:

- \"One clue. Keep it clever.\"
- \"NO SAYING THE WORD\"
- The individual player's typed clue turn.
- The \"Type a one-word clue...\" input field.
- The \"Give clue\" button.
- Any other UI elements exclusively used by typed clue mode.

This screen should no longer appear anywhere in the game.

3. Make verbal clues the permanent game mode

The existing verbal clue flow should become the default and only game flow.

The sequence should be:

1. Everyone privately reveals their role.
2. The Game Start screen appears and displays the randomly selected starting player.
3. The starting player taps \"START VERBAL DISCUSSION\".
4. The Discussion screen appears.
5. Players give clues aloud and discuss the secret word.
6. The existing \"CONTINUE TO VOTING\" button takes players to voting.
7. Existing voting and subsequent round mechanics continue normally.

There should be no typed clue phase between these steps.

4. Clean up related implementation

Inspect the code for typed-clue-only logic and remove obsolete functionality where safe.

This includes:

- Typed clue input state.
- Typed clue validation.
- Clue submission handlers.
- Typed clue-specific transitions.
- Typed clue-only conditional rendering.
- Any obsolete settings or stored state exclusively required by typed clue mode.

Do not remove shared game logic that is still needed by verbal clues, voting, or other features.

If older saved party settings contain a typed-clue preference, handle them safely so they do not cause errors.

5. Preserve existing verbal clue functionality

Keep:

- Random starting-player selection for every new round.
- Avoidance of the previous round's starting player whenever another eligible player exists.
- Existing party-level starting-player rotation between matches.
- Active-player eligibility.
- Discussion timer setting.
- Existing Game Start screen.
- Existing Discussion screen.
- Existing starting-player display and buttons.
- Existing voting, elimination, win conditions, and final guessing.

Do not accidentally reset or break starting-player rotation.

6. Preserve the existing design

Keep the Premium Editorial theme exactly as it is.

Do not redesign the settings page or game screens.

Maintain the existing colours, typography, cards, buttons, gradients, paper texture, spacing, and visual styling.

7. Testing

Verify:

- The typed clue setting no longer appears.
- The typed clue screen can no longer be reached.
- No typed clue input or submission button appears.
- The game always follows the verbal clue flow.
- Starting-player selection still works correctly for every round.
- Discussion can proceed to voting.
- Voting and all subsequent game mechanics still work.
- Existing parties and saved data remain intact.
- No obsolete typed-clue references cause runtime errors.

FINAL INSTRUCTION:

Remove typed clue mode completely, not merely hide its toggle. Make verbal clues the permanent game mode. Keep every other working feature unchanged. Do not redesign or refactor unrelated parts of the application.

---
This is a build request. Build a complete, playable game now (or apply the requested change to the existing game). Do not ask clarifying questions; make reasonable assumptions and note them briefly when you finish.

Screenshots for your own checks: save small JPEGs (a .jpg path, viewport at most 1280px wide) and read only the latest one; older images are dropped from context. Read a full-size PNG only when fine detail matters.
"

#!/usr/bin/env bash
set -euo pipefail

PROJECT_DIR="$(cd "$(dirname "${BASH_SOURCE[0]}")" && pwd)"
STATIC_DIR="$PROJECT_DIR"
: "${OPENCODE_WEB_DIR:?OPENCODE_WEB_DIR must point to worker metadata storage}"
: "${RUNTIME_DIR:?RUNTIME_DIR must point to the worker runtime}"
PORT="${PORT:-3000}"
export PORT

cd "$PROJECT_DIR"
/usr/bin/time -p test -f "$STATIC_DIR/index.html"

# This project is plain HTML/CSS/JS with no package manifest or build step.
/usr/bin/time -p mkdir -p "$OPENCODE_WEB_DIR"
/usr/bin/time -p env PROJECT_DIR="$PROJECT_DIR" STATIC_DIR="$STATIC_DIR" node -e 'const fs=require("node:fs"); const path=require("node:path"); fs.writeFileSync(path.join(process.env.OPENCODE_WEB_DIR,"deployment-output.json"), JSON.stringify({project:process.env.PROJECT_DIR,directory:process.env.STATIC_DIR}))'

# Keep the worker's static server in the foreground for controller lifecycle management.
exec /usr/bin/time -p node "$RUNTIME_DIR/scripts/default-start.mjs"
#!/usr/bin/env bash
set -euo pipefail

PROJECT_DIR="$(cd "$(dirname "${BASH_SOURCE[0]}")" && pwd)"
: "${RUNTIME_DIR:?RUNTIME_DIR must point to the worker runtime}"
: "${CAPTURE_URL:?Set CAPTURE_URL to the exact preview URL}"
: "${CAPTURE_DIR:?Set CAPTURE_DIR to an absolute output directory}"

if [[ "$CAPTURE_DIR" != /* ]]; then
  echo 'CAPTURE_DIR must be an absolute path.' >&2
  exit 1
fi

/usr/bin/time -p test -f "$RUNTIME_DIR/scripts/default-capture.mjs"
/usr/bin/time -p test -f "$HOME/.local/share/omgithub-playwright/linux.json"
/usr/bin/time -p test -f "$HOME/.local/share/omgithub-playwright/display"
/usr/bin/time -p mkdir -p "$CAPTURE_DIR"
CAPTURE_DIR="$(/usr/bin/time -p realpath -m "$CAPTURE_DIR")"
case "$CAPTURE_DIR/" in
  "$PROJECT_DIR/"*)
    echo 'CAPTURE_DIR must be outside the project source tree.' >&2
    exit 1
    ;;
esac

# The runtime capture implementation owns and closes its Chromium instance,
# distinguishes temporary navigation/browser errors, and writes the required filenames.
/usr/bin/time -p env \
  CAPTURE_AUTO_START=false \
  CAPTURE_STRICT=1 \
  CAPTURE_READY_SELECTOR='#app > .hero-line' \
  CAPTURE_URL="$CAPTURE_URL" \
  CAPTURE_DIR="$CAPTURE_DIR" \
  node "$RUNTIME_DIR/scripts/default-capture.mjs"
